quotes.text: An army marches on its stomach.
quotes.author: Napoleon Bonaparte

quotes.text: Death is nothing, but to live defeated and inglorious is to die daily.
quotes.author: Napoleon Bonaparte

quotes.text: Courage is like love; it must have hope for nourishment.
quotes.author: Napoleon Bonaparte

quotes.text: The battlefield is a scene of constant chaos. The winner will be the one who controls that chaos, both his own and the enemies.
quotes.author: Napoleon Bonaparte

quotes.text: In war, the moral is to the physical as three is to one.
quotes.author: Napoleon Bonaparte

quotes.text: Ten people who speak make more noise than ten thousand who are silent.
quotes.author: Napoleon Bonaparte

quotes.text: History is a set of lies agreed upon.
quotes.author: Napoleon Bonaparte

quotes.text: Impossible is a word to be found only in the dictionary of fools.
quotes.author: Napoleon Bonaparte

quotes.text: A leader is a dealer in hope.
quotes.author: Napoleon Bonaparte

quotes.text: The strong man is the one who is able to intercept at will the communication between the senses and the mind.
quotes.author: Napoleon Bonaparte

quotes.text: In war, there is but one favorable moment; the great art is to seize it.
quotes.author: Napoleon Bonaparte

quotes.text: The surest way to remain poor is to be an honest man.
quotes.author: Napoleon Bonaparte

quotes.text: Victory belongs to the most persevering.
quotes.author: Napoleon Bonaparte

quotes.text: I am sometimes a fox and sometimes a lion. The whole secret of government lies in knowing when to be the one or the other.
quotes.author: Napoleon Bonaparte

quotes.text: If you want a thing done well, do it yourself.
quotes.author: Napoleon Bonaparte
